reference_sql:
SELECT s.product_id, ph.list_price_eur, SUM(s.units) AS units
FROM sales s
JOIN price_history ph ON ph.product_id = s.product_id
WHERE s.parent_category = 'Audio'
  AND ph.valid_to IS NULL
GROUP BY s.product_id, ph.list_price_eur
alternatives: WITH current_prices AS (SELECT product_id, list_price_eur FROM price_history WHERE valid_to IS NULL), product_units AS (SELECT product_id, SUM(units) AS units FROM sales WHERE parent_category = 'Audio' GROUP BY product_id) SELECT u.product_id, c.list_price_eur, u.units FROM product_units u JOIN current_prices c ON c.product_id = u.product_id

solver.query:
WITH sold AS (
  SELECT product_id, SUM(units) AS units
  FROM sales
  WHERE parent_category = 'Audio'
  GROUP BY product_id
)
SELECT s.product_id, h.list_price_eur, s.units
FROM sold s
JOIN price_history h ON h.product_id = s.product_id AND h.valid_to IS NULL
